wardDetail.title: California SR precinct review comparison with city splits
wardDetail.detail: Official California Statewide Database 2024 General Election SOV by SR precinct is loaded for President-vs-U.S. Senate review rows. SR precincts are assigned to cities using the official SRPREC-to-city conversion table when at least half of the precinct population maps inside the city. SWDB masks small precinct candidate fields, so masked or incomplete rows are excluded from review graph points.
wardDetail.sourceTimestampBasis: Official California Statewide Database 2024 General Election statewide SOV and geography conversion files.
